description.name: Basic Attack: Gale Hammer Combo
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches up to 3 Strikes forward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during the 3rd attack to activate <color=#ffffff>[Basic Attack: Meteor Hammer]</color>;
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> during the 3rd attack to directly enter the <color=#FFFFFF>[Spin]</color> state.

description.name: Basic Attack: Meteor Hammer
description.desc:
Automatically activated after the 3rd hit of <color=#ffffff>[Basic Attack: Gale Combo Hammer]</color>, or when <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Riding the Wind]</color> ends without <color=#ffffff>[Wind Energy]</color>:
Delivers a powerful Strike downward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.

description.name: Basic Attack: Whirlwind Hammer
Dodge: Tailwind
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
Perform a quick dodge to the side.

description.name: Dash Attack: Wind Chase
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.

description.name: Dodge Counter: Headwind
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Strike enemies ahead, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Special Attack: Wind Gather
description.desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Strike forward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.

description.name: EX Special Attack: Ride the Wind
EX Special Attack: Wind Cannon
description.desc:
<color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Riding the Wind]</color> ends and <color=#ffffff>[Wind Energy]</color> exists, automatically activates:
Consume all <color=#ffffff>[Wind Energy]</color> to fire a wind cannon forward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>;
For each point of <color=#ffffff>[Wind Energy]</color> consumed, deal an additional instance of <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color> after the attack and generate 1 <color=#ffffff>[Eye of the Wind]</color> at the original position;
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Eye of the Storm
description.desc:
<color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Wind Cannon]</color> Generated after consuming <color=#ffffff>[Wind Energy]</color>, lasts 30 seconds;
A maximum of 3 <color=#ffffff>[Wind Eyes]</color> can exist simultaneously. When the limit is exceeded, the earliest generated <color=#ffffff>[Wind Eye]</color> will automatically detonate;
When hit by <color=#ffffff>[Basic Attack: Cyclone Hammer]</color> or <color=#ffffff>[Ultimate: Storm Rampage]</color>, they will be detonated. If fewer than 3 are hit simultaneously, a small tornado will be generated at each <color=#ffffff>[Wind Eye]</color> position, tracking enemies and dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color> for 2 seconds;
If 3 are hit simultaneously, a large tornado will be generated instead, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color> for 1 second.
When detonated by any means, <color=#ffffff>[Wind Eyes]</color> deal <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color> to nearby enemies.

description.name: Chain Attack: Storm Incoming
description.desc:
When a <color=#ffffff>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful strike at enemies ahead, dealing massive <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
After using this skill, restore 1 <color=#ffffff>Wind Energy</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Ultimate: Storm Rampage
description.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Unleashes a powerful strike at enemies in front in a large area, dealing massive <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Assist: Counter
Quick Assist: Gale Cover
description.desc:
When the on-field character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Strikes forward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Defensive Assist: Wind Wall
description.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Launches a Strike against enemies ahead, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of <color=#FFFFFF>[Assist Points]</color> when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

description.name: Assist Follow-Up: Windbreak
description.desc:
After using <color=#ffffff>[Defensive Assist]</color>, Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches a Strike forward, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>.

1.name: Mindscape 1
1.desc: When <color=#ffffff>[Eye of the Storm]</color> is detonated by any means, its DMG is increased by 15% and Daze is increased by 15%; when <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Wind Cannon]</color> hits, reduces the enemy's All-Attribute RES by 15% for 40s.

2.name: Mindscape 02
2.desc: For each <color=#ffffff>[Wind Eye]</color> detonated, the next <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Ride the Wind]</color> deals 5% more Daze, up to a max of 15%. When switching out via <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Ride the Wind]</color>, Roxy maintains <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Ride the Wind]</color> for 0.3s without consuming Energy, up to a max of 0.9s. When <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Rising Wind]</color> or <color=#ffffff>[EX Special Attack: Ride the Wind]</color> hits an enemy, increases the enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier by 25%, lasting until the target recovers from the Stunned state.

4.name: Mindscape 04
4.desc: When <color=#ffffff>[Basic Attack: Gale Combo Hammer]</color> hits an enemy, recover 1 Energy, up to 1 time per skill use; when <color=#ffffff>[Dodge Counter: Headwind]</color>, <color=#ffffff>[Entry Skill]</color>, or <color=#ffffff>[Basic Attack: Meteor Hammer]</color> hits an enemy, recover 2 Energy, up to 1 time per skill use; <color=#ffffff>[Ultimate: Raging Storm]</color> DMG increases by 25%, and Daze increases by 10%.

6.name: Mindscape 06
6.desc: When <color=#ffffff>[Basic Attack: Whirlwind Hammer]</color> detonates <color=#ffffff>[Eye of the Storm]</color> to generate a large tornado, the primary target is afflicted with the <color=#ffffff>[Vengeance]</color> effect, generating a large tornado at the target's location once every 3 seconds, for a total of 4 additional large tornadoes. The large tornado's DMG Multiplier is increased by 400%, and the Daze inflicted is increased by 100%. Upon repeated triggers, the additional generation count stacks.
